PuTTY_0.77_msvc143_x86_puttytel.exe.build_flags: /MD /O2 /Ob2 /Zi (CMake Release without /DNDEBUG, which upstream's cmake/setup.cmake removes so assertions stay on), upstream's /wd4244 /wd4267 /wd4018 /wd4146 /wd4293 /wd4090; link /INCREMENTAL:NO /DEBUG /Brepro /OPT:NOREF /OPT:NOICF plus upstream's /dynamicbase /nxcompat; no /GL, no /LTCG; NMake Makefiles generator
PuTTY_0.77_msvc143_x86_puttytel.exe.compiler: Microsoft (R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version 19.44.35229 for x86
PuTTY_0.77_msvc143_x86_puttytel.exe.notes: Same tarball, digest, compiler and flags as the six-tool MSVC recipe beside it: puttytel.exe (the Telnet/raw/serial-only build of the PuTTY GUI) and psocks.exe (the SOCKS proxy server built on PuTTY's port-forwarding code), cl (v143) against the DLL runtime (/MD). A separate recipe so the six committed images are not rebuilt.
